Requirements section is 'Du', which has no optional marker, so items default to required.
GCP carries the inline marker 'vorzugsweise' (preferably), so it is nice_to_have.
AWS, Azure and GCP are labeled as examples of one ask (Public Cloud) and form alternative_group 1.
The cloud criterion stays out of the group.
GitHub maps to git through its alias, so the only grouped candidate is git; that leaves no group.
GitLab is not in the taxonomy (gitlab-ci is a CI product, not version control), so it goes to unmapped.
Bitbucket goes to unmapped.
Terraform and IaC are both named in 'Terraform (IaC)', so each is labeled.
The 'Generative AI-Anwendungen' bullet asks for 'erste Erfahrungen' (first experience), which is still experience. llms is required.
Vertex AI, LangChain, Gemini, Cloud Run and Cloud Build appear only in the responsibilities, so they are not labeled.
'Sicherheitskonzepten' is under 'idealerweise' (ideally). It is mapped to cybersecurity via the alias 'sicherheitskonzepte' and marked uncertain: it may read as domain or compliance knowledge.
Cloud certifications are not a skill.
Seniority: 'einschlägige Erfahrung' and 'erfahrene' are not level signals.
The one junior-ish phrase is 'erste Erfahrungen', and it covers only the GenAI bullet. I left seniority null and flagged it.
